title: 汇丰高管：AI债务供给压力显现，大型交易难度上升
speaker: Michael Murray Roberts

segments.en: I think mix with a little bit of caution in the financial markets today given the amount of quantum of debt that's been raised as an example
segments.zh: 我认为当前金融市场需要多一些谨慎，因为已经发行的债务规模相当大。

segments.en: I think there'll be a supply demand issue that we'll have to look at. Too much demand for capital with not enough supply of terms of the revenue coming back.
segments.zh: 我认为会出现供需问题，需要关注。对资金的需求过多，而收入回报的供给不足。

segments.en: I think there is a lot of not questioning fun on the fundamentals of AI but more of the pacing and the overall benefits and the returns that you'll get on the investment.
segments.zh: 我认为人们并不是质疑AI的基本面，而是更关注节奏、整体收益以及配置回报。

segments.en: Do you actually see corporate pushback or investor pushback to absorbing more of this debt? Do you think that's actually going to slow the pipeline of issuance from some of these tech companies?
segments.zh: 您是否看到企业或投资者对吸收更多债务有抵触？您认为这会减缓一些科技公司的发行节奏吗？

segments.en: It clearly we're starting to see prices rise clearly. I think there's you know deals are getting tougher to place. I think the ease of the initial transactions that we're done in terms of terms of conditions has changed.
segments.zh: 显然我们开始看到价格上升。交易变得更难完成，最初那些交易在条款上的轻松程度已经改变。

segments.en: I think lenders are going to be much more focused on proper returns proper structure things of that nature the deal sizes are very very large.
segments.zh: 我认为贷款机构将更加关注合理的回报、合理的结构等。交易规模非常非常大。

segments.en: So by that very nature they're more difficult to do. I mean, I'll give you examples some of the transactions of 40 billion dollars. Those are usually large acquisitions of investment grade companies which are
segments.zh: 因此本质上这些交易更难完成。举个例子，有些交易规模达400亿美元，通常是投资级公司的大型收购。

segments.en: Don't come that often are fairly easy to place. This is a constant flow of very large transactions. So I do think again that supply demand dynamic is going to start working against really the issuers.
segments.zh: 这类交易并不常见，通常较容易完成。但现在是持续不断的大规模交易流。所以我再次认为供需动态将开始对发行方不利。

segments.en: And I think they understand that it's just a huge amount of debt to be issued.
segments.zh: 我认为他们明白，将要发行的债务规模巨大。
